system.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
system.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against your target’s Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Grab.
Critical Success The target is Restrained until the start of your next Opportunity.
Success The target is Grabbed until the your next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Tackle.
Critical Success The target is knocked Prone or Supine (your choice, subject to GM judgment call), and Restrained until your next Opportunity.
Success The target is knocked Prone or Supine (your choice, subject to GM judgment call), and Grabbed until your next Opportunity. You fall Prone adjacent to them.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and fall Prone.
